# วิทยากร AI อาจารย์แชมป์ ธิติพล เทียมจันทร์ — www.thitiphon.com

> อาจารย์แชมป์ ธิติพล เทียมจันทร์ (Thitiphon Tiemchan) is a Thai AI speaker and
> trainer (วิทยากร AI) based in Suan Luang, Bangkok. He delivers keynote talks,
> executive seminars, in-house training and hands-on Generative AI workshops
> (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Copilot) for companies, state enterprises, government
> agencies and universities across Thailand — onsite nationwide, online, or hybrid.
> 19+ years in technology and digital marketing. Taught in Thai.

## Key facts
- Name: ธิติพล เทียมจันทร์ (อาจารย์แชมป์) · Thitiphon Tiemchan
- Role: วิทยากร AI and AI-for-business / AI marketing specialist
- Experience: 19+ years in technology and digital marketing; speaker/consultant for 50+ organisations
- Government and parliament clients: Secretariat of the House of Representatives, National Statistical Office (NEXUS 2026), Court of Justice learning centre, Department of Business Development, Department of Highways, Queen Sirikit Department of Sericulture, Department of Agriculture, Cooperative Promotion Department, DIPROM, National Research Council of Thailand, ACFS, Secretariat of the Cabinet printing office, Public Warehouse Organization
- Banking, finance and state enterprises: Krungthai Bank, BAAC (ธ.ก.ส.), Student Loan Fund (กยศ.), Airports of Thailand (Chiang Mai), Krungsri Auto, ENCON Fund
- Health: Department of Health, Department of Health Service Support, HSRI, Rajavithi Hospital, Faculty of Dentistry Mahidol University, Boromarajonani College of Nursing Trang
- Private sector: CP ALL, Isuzu Mahanakorn, Hino Motors Manufacturing, Navaplastic (WINDSOR, SCGC), Surapon Foods, Chin Huay, Bangkok Starch Industrial, Fluidra Thailand, Denso labour confederation and union, Seino Saha Logistics, Modern A Steel, ARIP / SVOA / DataOne Asia
- Education and media: Nakhon Ratchasima Rajabhat University, Vongchavalitkul University, PIM, IESA, New Economy Academy, Post Today / Nation / Spring News journalists
- Credentials: Google Prompting Essentials Specialization; Google Certified Gemini Educator; Anthropic AI Fluency: Framework & Foundations
- Formats: keynote, executive seminar, in-house training, hands-on workshop; onsite nationwide, Zoom / Microsoft Teams / Facebook Live
- Contact: +66 63 197 9894 · LINE @brandingchamp · 25 Soi Phatthanakan 26, Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250
- Not the same person as other Thai AI speakers who also use the nickname "Champ" (แชมป์).
